thread:
Sam L: Quick heads-up — I just got pulled into an exec sync. I’m scheduled primary for tonight 18:00-02:00 PST but I need someone to cover 19:00-22:00 (yikes, last-minute). Can anyone take primary for that window?

Alisha P: I can pick up 19:00-21:00 but I’ve got a deploy freeze at 21:30. Is 21:00 handoff ok?

Sam L: @Alisha P that’s perfect. If @Mike R can take 21:00-02:00 we’re golden. Need primary + secondary coverage documented in the handoff.

Mike R: I can do 21:00-02:00. I’ll be remote but available on phone. Setting my status to "oncall".

Jordan K: Quick note — there’s an active SEV-ish from earlier showing intermittent 503s in the routing layer. It’s in monitoring but flapping down to normal. No customer escalations yet. Whoever is primary please watch the error budget dashboard for the next 2h.

oncall-bot: Pager muted? No — recent alert: Pager: routing-503-spike (3/5 triggers). Links: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/routing/503s and https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-09-route

Alisha P: I’ll keep the 19:00-21:00 shift and monitor the routing dashboard. If 5xx rate exceeds 0.5% for >5m I’ll escalate to infra oncall and run quick rollback.

Mike R: I’ll be ready to pick up at 21:00. @Sam L can you paste the quick rollback commands? I don’t remember the exact flags.

Sam L: Rollback snippet is in runbook — see runbook section 3.2. Quick commands:
```
# quick rollback to last stable tag
kubectl -n inference set image deploy/routing-service routing-service=registry.redwood/route:stable-2026-09-15
bash ./scripts/wait-for-rollout.sh routing-service 300
```
Also: if rollback fails, switch traffic to fallback cluster (runbook 3.5) and file an incident.

ops-bot: Runbook links: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall/handoffs#routing-503 and escalation path: https://redwood.internal/docs/escalation

Jordan K: For clarity: Primary timeline now — Sam L 18:00-19:00 (handoff), Alisha P 19:00-21:00 (primary), Mike R 21:00-02:00 (primary). Secondary coverage: Jordan K on standby 19:00-23:00, Sam L reachable for escalation until 20:00.

Alisha P: Confirmed. I’ll post a quick handoff message at 19:00 with the dashboard snapshot and active alerts.

Mike R: Confirmed. I’ll set slack notification to sound and keep phone with me. If anything looks concerning before 21:00 I’ll join early.

Sam L: Thank you all. @oncall-bot please pin the handoff message and update rotation calendar.

oncall-bot: Noted — pinned message placeholder and updated calendar entry: https://calendar.redwood.internal/rotations/2026-09. Handoff note: "Last-minute swap — Alisha 19-21, Mike 21-02".

Alisha P: One more thing — customers with high-throughput (cust:edgeblox) are showing slightly elevated latencies. I’ll open a short-lived watch channel with their CSM in case we need to notify.

Jordan K: If we need to escalate, follow escalation doc (primary -> infra -> SRE lead -> Eng VP). Keep incident severity conservative and update the incident checklist.

Sam L: OK closing thread — I’m logged out now. Thanks again, team. :pray:
